title: [AUG-114] Migrate August from web app to Electron desktop application
why_we_need_this: August currently runs as a localhost web app — users must start a Node server from terminal and open a browser tab. Non-technical users cannot install or use the product. Wrapping the app in Electron produces a single installable artifact (.dmg for macOS, .msi for Windows) with one-click launch, no Node.js prerequisite, and native desktop features (tray icon, global hotkeys, notifications). Distribution via GitHub Releases.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Electron shell wraps the existing React + Vite client and Node.js/Express server
- [ ] Express server runs inside Electron's main process (or as a managed child process) — no separate terminal needed
- [ ] whisper-cli binary spawning works unchanged inside Electron (child_process)
- [ ] Production build produces distributable installers: .dmg (macOS) and .msi (Windows)
- [ ] Auto-update mechanism configured for GitHub Releases (electron-updater)
- [ ] App launches with a single click — window opens with the React UI, server starts in background
- [ ] System tray integration — app minimizes to tray, shows transcription status
- [ ] Global hotkey for start/stop recording (configurable)
- [ ] Native OS notifications for transcription completion
- [ ] Code signing configured for both platforms (Apple Developer + Windows Authenticode)
- [ ] Vite dev mode still works for development (electron + vite dev server)
- [ ] All existing features (sessions, upload, live transcription, file recording) work identically inside Electron
- [ ] App icon and branding applied to the desktop shell
- [ ] README updated with Electron build/dev/release instructions
important_constraints:
- Do not refactor the Express server into Electron IPC — keep it running as-is inside the main process to minimize migration risk
- Do not break the existing web-app dev workflow — `npm run dev` should still work for browser-based development
- All inference must remain local via whisper-cli — no third-party API calls
- Keep the client/server directory structure; add electron/ as a new directory for Electron-specific code (main process, preload, electron-builder config)
- Memory matters: whisper inference uses 2-4GB RAM, so minimize Electron's footprint where possible (disable unused Chromium features)
